skill.name: summarize-competitor-pricing
skill.description: Open competitors' live pricing pages and write a one-page comparison of tiers, inclusions and limits. Use when someone wants a current competitor price comparison.
skill.summary: Delegate live pricing research to MyClawn and return a one-page comparison with a screenshot and recording link.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a supporting documentation link, with no instruction to transmit user data to it. No evidence found of malicious instructions or data exfiltration in SKILL.md. The workflow requires a signed-in MyClawn connector and user approval before third-party submissions.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/summarize-compe

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 labels the MyClawn URL as a full task description; its query parameters contain campaign labels, not user data. The skill does not instruct the agent to upload information to this URL or treat its contents as overriding instructions.

content.value_statement: Competitor pricing pages spread tier details and usage limits across separate sites. This skill delegates browser research to MyClawn and requests a one-page comparison.
actual_capabilities: Delegate visits to competitor pricing pages through the MyClawn Computer connector.
Adapt the competitor list and comparison criteria to the user request.
Request a one-page comparison of published pricing tiers, inclusions, seat limits, and storage limits.
Define the research goal, target sites, output format, and prohibited actions in the delegated task.
Return the connector result with a screenshot and screen recording link.
Require user review of final wording before form submissions, bookings, or other third-party writes.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; the skill does not include a standalone browser or research engine.
Can report only visible pricing information, not unpublished quotes available through sales calls.
Login pages and captchas require user participation.
Research completion and screenshot or recording availability depend on the external connector.

use_cases.title: Evaluate subscription options
use_cases.description: Compare published plans and seat limits before selecting a tool for a team.

use_cases.title: Review competing offers
use_cases.description: Compare competitor tiers, included features, and storage limits to inform product packaging discussions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client comparison
use_cases.description: Request a concise pricing overview and visual evidence for a client evaluating software vendors.

prompt_templates.title: Compare three competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the live pricing pages of Notion, Coda, and Slite. Summarize tiers, inclusions, seat limits, and storage limits on one page.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: request a standard pricing comparison.

prompt_templates.title: Specify comparison criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [competitor A], [competitor B], and [competitor C]. Include displayed prices, billing periods, included features, seat limits, and storage limits. Mark missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: tailor the research to a purchasing checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Support a team purchase
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [competitors] for a [team size]-person team using their public pricing pages. Separate monthly and annual billing. Flag unclear limits and sales-only pricing. Do not submit forms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate pricing against a specific team requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Define research boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [pricing page URLs] for [requirements]. Produce a one-page comparison with source links and unresolved questions. Do not contact sales or change accounts. Return the screenshot and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: constrain browsing and specify the evidence required.

output_examples.input: Illustrative page data: Alpha costs $10 per seat monthly with 5 GB storage; Beta costs $12 with 20 GB. Compare both.
output: Alpha: $10 per seat per month, with 5 GB storage.
Beta: $12 per seat per month, with 20 GB storage.
Beta costs $2 more per seat monthly and includes 15 GB more storage.
Seat limits and other inclusions are not supplied in this illustrative data.

output_examples.input: Illustrative page data: Gamma lists a free plan for three seats; Enterprise says contact sales. Summarize availability without contacting sales.
output: Free: supports three seats; storage allowance is not provided in the supplied data.
Enterprise: price is not published; a sales quote is required.
The supplied information does not support a paid-plan cost comparison.

best_practices: Provide exact competitor names or pricing URLs and specify the limits that matter.
Ask the comparison to distinguish billing periods, currencies, and unpublished prices.
Review the returned evidence and participate directly when login or captcha challenges appear.
anti_patterns: Treating sales-only pricing or missing limits as known values.
Requesting account creation, purchases, or form submissions without reviewing the final wording.
Assuming the skill includes its own connector or can bypass login and captcha requirements.

faq.question: What must be connected before using this skill?
faq.answer: The MyClawn Computer connector must be signed in. The skill references the repository's cloud-computer-task skill for setup.

faq.question: Which competitors can I compare?
faq.answer: You can replace the example competitors with your own names or pricing pages and specify the comparison criteria.

faq.question: Can it retrieve prices available only through sales?
faq.answer: No. It reads visible page information and cannot establish unpublished prices from the page alone.

faq.question: What happens when a page requires login or a captcha?
faq.answer: You must handle the login or solve the captcha on the live screen.

faq.question: What does the workflow return?
faq.answer: It requests a one-page comparison and reports the connector answer, a screenshot, and a screen recording link.

faq.question: Will it submit forms or contact competitors automatically?
faq.answer: The instructions require showing you the final wording before sending anything that submits a form, books something, or writes to a third party.
